Druid and modern Hadoop ecosystem use netty 4.x (io.netty.* package). The netty 3.x jar uses the legacy org.jboss.netty.* package and is bundled as a transitive of hadoop-common via druid-iceberg-extensions, druid-parquet-extensions, druid-orc-extensions, and ranger-plugins-common, but no code in the image loads org.jboss.netty.* classes. The vulnerable HttpObjectDecoder in netty 3.x is never instantiated.
